goal: Bind the replay seed to actual published commit IDs without changing the historical capture.
procedure: Upload exact local Git blob bytes through the connected GitHub app; require each returned blob digest and final tree SHA to equal the local snapshot; publish separate branches; change the active seed's code pins to the resulting public commit IDs.
authority: Public code publication and reference reconciliation only. No verified current 24 GB local source, behavior suppression, trained MFM or product qualification.
validation: Foundation and MFM remote trees equaled their local code snapshots. Seed JSON syntax checked; FBM branch publication remains to be verified.
failure_or_lesson: The GitHub connector recreated commits with different IDs from local Git; dependent procedure pins require the published IDs while historical local capture remains recorded.
